coverage.method: Structured records, deduplicated messages, connected tool calls/results, queued commands; images located, not every image visually inspected.
7353 records; 40 prose, 834 tool calls/results, 128 enqueue/remove, 6 queued completions; 246 related workflow completion results.
Final prose, 87 tool calls index, actual AskUserQuestion calls/results and final file Write; Desktop start/end UI matched to source.

limitations: All records were indexed and relevant prose/commands/results audited across three contexts; repeated hooks/polling grouped. Not every historical screenshot or binary payload was visually re-read.
Historical findings have not all been revalidated against current HEAD.
Paper UI was read without edit authentication; MCP screenshot/edit access was denied.
